summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish testing of TerraMart. All 4 targeted backend endpoints work correctly. Frontend core flows (home, category, product detail, cart, buyer signup+logout, seller signup+dashboard) all pass. Only minor spec drift in category nav slugs.
passed: Backend: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns 200 + user object
Backend: GET /api/seller/dashboard with buyer Bearer returns 403 'Seller access required' (NOT 401)
Backend: seller1 login + GET /api/seller/dashboard returns 200 with seller + stats (products:4, revenue:45000, rating:4.5)
Backend: POST /api/products/{id}/reviews with buyer token returns 200; product rating aggregate updated (reviews_count=1)
Frontend: Homepage renders header-logo, header-search-input, header-cart-link, header-login-link, header-seller-link, banner-carousel; 7 category-nav links render
Frontend: /category/tiles renders products-grid with 4 product cards; filter-min-price, filter-max-price, filter-rating-4, sort-select all present
Frontend: Product detail page loads, thumbnails switch main image, variant selection works, add-to-cart triggers sticky-cart
Frontend: Cart page shows 2 items with qty-inc, qty-dec, remove controls all functional
Frontend: Buyer signup with unique email redirects to /, header-account-btn renders with user initials
Frontend: header-account-btn -> header-logout-btn logs out, header-login-link reappears
Frontend: Seller signup redirects to /seller/dashboard; seller-stats visible; 'Verification pending' badge shown for new seller; add-product-btn visible

failed.issue: Review request expected data-testids cat-nav-sanitaryware, cat-nav-hardware, cat-nav-lighting but actual app exposes cat-nav-wall-stencils, cat-nav-wall-stickers, cat-nav-home-decor (categories API returns tiles, wall-stencils, wall-stickers, wallpapers, paints, home-decor, flooring)
failed.evidence: GET /api/categories returned 7 categories with different slugs than review spec; UI still renders exactly 7 nav links

failed.issue: Could not verify price_asc sort ordering because product cards do not expose a data-testid starting with 'product-price-' (price cell has no dedicated testid). Sort dropdown itself works and reloads grid.
failed.evidence: product-price-* selector returned 0 elements after selecting price_asc

action_items: Optional: Add data-testid='product-price-{id}' on product card price element to make price sort verifiable in tests
Optional: Reconcile review-request category slug list with actual categories (tiles, wall-stencils, wall-stickers, wallpapers, paints, home-decor, flooring)
